title: Aye Mere Bhai Abbas
body:
Aye Mere Bhai Abbas
Abbas
<<MINI>>
Aye Mere Bhai Abbas, Abbas Abbas
Aye Mere Bhai Abbas, Abbas Abbas
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi har ghaam aakle saahe gaye hai
Abbas
<<MINI>>
Aye Mere Bhai Abbas, Abbas Abbas
Aye Mere Bhai Abbas, Abbas Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Bekaso Mazloom Ka Pyasa Gala Katta Gaya
Zaqmi Sarwar Kay Labo Par Naam Tha Abbas Ka
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi, Tum Ko Bulate Rehgaye Hai
2. Hathkadi Bedi May Jakhde Abid e Bemaar ko
Taaziyaaney Maartey Hai Bekas O Lachaar Ko
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi Majboor Kitni Hogayi Hai
3. Naaz Tha Jin Bazuon Par Kat gaye Bazu Wahi
Dek kr Ye Be-Radi ko Mein Roti Hu Khadi
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi Abbas Kahte Rehgaye Hai
4. Bin Terey Aay Merey Gazi Ye Bahan Kaisey Jiye
Kisko Ab Rokar Pukaarey Kisko Ab Bhai Kahey
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi Karbobala May Lutgayi Hai
5. Shazadaadi k Bandi Hai Aaj Dekho Reesma
Har Khadam Par Muj ko Bhai Yaad Aaye Baba Jaan
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi Koofey Mein Aa Kay Kho Gaye Hai
6. Zulm The Koofe Mein Kaisa Tere Qahar k Liye
Mai Tarasti Rehgayi Bas Ek Chadar Kay Liye
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi Baalo Se Parda Kargayi Hai
7. Kitna Parde Ka Qayal Tum Ko Mere Rehta Tha
Sham Kay Bazar Mein Layie Gaye Hu Be-Rida
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi Dekho Tamasha Bangaye Hai
8. Be-rida Hone Se Phle Hoti Mein Zare Zameen
Hai Kaneezo kay Mohaafiz Aur Mera Koi Nahi
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi Kitni Aakali Hogaye Hai
9. Kya Qayamat k Masayab Chaar Saala Saeh Gaye
Har Tamachey Par Sakina Yaad Karti Rehgaye
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi zinda'n May Ghut Kay Margayi Hai
10. Gham Sahey Itney Kay Aankho May Andhera Chaa Gaya
Hai Kamar Meri Khamida Chalti Hu lekar Aasa
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi Kaisi Zaaefa Hogayi Hai
11. Dekho Ghar Umullbanee'n Ka Arsh Aab Veraan Hai
Thay Jahan Atharra Bhai Wo Maka'n Sunsaan Hai
<<MINI>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Tere Aaqa Zadi Jeetey Jee Dekho Margayi Hai
